summary: Bessel of frequency 1 and supported where some u ∈ 𝖴 brings the point into the box.

steps.lean:
lemma isCut_complexLevel : hF.complexLevel.IsCut F := have h := hF.isBesselFunction .cut
  ⟨⟨h.1, by simpa using h.2⟩,
    (_root_.exists_norm_le_of_besselSize_le <| hF.rho_eq ▸ hF.inCut_of_ne_zero _ ·)⟩
steps.claim: F is a Bessel function (cut side of the pair), so bounded measurable with the 𝖴-law of frequency 1 = g⁻¹; if F(x) ≠ 0 then besselSize(x) ≤ ρ (InCut, ρ = b^{6(ϱ+1)+2}), so some u ∈ 𝖴 has ‖ux‖ ≤ ρ, i.e. ux in the box.
